architecture.optional_synthesis: Gemini API (gemini-2.5-flash) — active only when GEMINI_API_KEY is set

policy_stance_headline_audit.data_coverage_limitation: All 23 audited fed_news.json RSS items lack statement/speech body text, so ground-truth policy_stance is NEUTRAL (0 HAWKISH / 0 DOVISH support). Metric measures non-hallucination abstention accuracy rather than full-text HAWKISH/DOVISH discrimination.

xauusd_bias_headline_audit.data_coverage_limitation: All 23 audited fed_news.json RSS items lack directional macro prints, so ground-truth xauusd_bias is NEUTRAL (0 BULLISH / 0 BEARISH support).

honest_limitations: ml/data/fed_news.json contains 45 Fed RSS headlines/venues (42 unique after 3 cross-feed FOMC duplicates), without full FOMC statement or speech body texts.
BLS RSS feed was not present in the cached fed_news.json snapshot.
GEMINI_API_KEY is not configured in the current environment; gemini_active remains false and no simulated LLM output or numerical forecast is invented.
Because held_out_manual_audit RSS headlines lack directional macro prints, directional HAWKISH/DOVISH and XAUUSD BULLISH/BEARISH Macro-F1 require full-text human-labeled releases.

leakage_and_data_constraints.bamlh0a0hym2_excluded_reason: Starts 2023-11-13; excluded to avoid backfilling future medians onto 2002-2023 events.
